Portrait of a Woman

A serene close-up captures a woman with dark, curly hair tied back, dressed in a cozy white knit sweater. Her calm, contemplative expression is highlighted by soft, even lighting that brings out the texture of her skin and the fabric of her clothing. The plain, neutral background ensures all attention remains on her face and posture, creating an intimate and introspective atmosphere.

This portrait, used as the cover image for the Apple Music artist page of 巴奈, introduces listeners to her musical persona. The metadata notes her popular tracks and albums, inviting fans to explore works like 《撐》 and 《太平洋的風》 on the platform.

Panai Portrait

Panai, the self-taught singer-songwriter of Puyuma and Amis heritage, is captured in a contemplative studio portrait. Panai Kusui on the Streets of Taiwan

Her calm yet resolute gaze reflects years of musical achievement—from her 2000 debut album "泥娃娃" to her 2024 Golden Melody Award—and her commitment to indigenous rights.

sources.description:
巴奈新專輯宣傳照

原住民歌手巴奈在推出第二張全創作專輯《愛，不到》之際，拍攝了一組復刻首張專輯《泥娃娃》封面構圖的宣傳照。照片中，她身著淺色長衫，單腳抬起倚靠深色牆面，雙手環抱膝蓋，神情沉靜，畫面低調卻富含情感張力。

新專輯收錄了巴奈20年前創作的青春私密愛情作品，並以探戈結合電子音效為主要曲風，象徵愛情與權力的微妙關係。MV在蘭嶼拍攝，虛實交錯的畫面中，她在海邊木屋頂復刻舊作封面，無預警落淚，呈現夢境與現實中孤獨自我的對話。

Panai Kusui in the Rice Fields

Panai Kusui, the renowned Taiwanese indigenous singer and activist, pauses in a vibrant green rice paddy, her gaze lifted toward the cloudy sky. Dressed in dark, flowing garments and a simple headscarf, she stands on a narrow earthen path that winds through the flooded rows of young rice plants. The distant misty mountains and expansive fields underscore her deep connection to the land and her cultural heritage.

Panai’s Enduring Stand for Indigenous Land Rights

Singer 巴奈, adorned with a floral crown and dressed in black, stands before a row of protest tents pitched on Ketagalan Boulevard near Taiwan’s Presidential Office. Posters behind her bear the characters “馬” and the English slogan “GET OUT,” symbolizing her call for President 蔡英文 to fulfill promises to indigenous communities. Since February 23, 2017, she and her husband 那布 have camped at this site and in 228 Peace Memorial Park, maintaining a sit‑in for over 2,200 days.

sources.description:
巴奈新書發表會側影

原住民歌手巴奈於華山文創園區舉辦自傳《巴奈回家》新書發表會，現場約200位文化界人士與原住民朋友到場祝福。她身著白色上衣，頭戴以野花與綠葉編織的花環，神情凝重地回顧自2017年2月起在凱達格蘭大道與228公園持續2644天的和平抗爭歷程。

活動中，蔣勳、馬世芳、馬躍．比吼等人先後致詞，肯定這場非暴力社會運動對原住民族歷史認識的推動。書中詳述巴奈與丈夫那布在無屋頂處度過七年抗爭生活的艱辛，以及原住民族被迫離開家園的歷史。巴奈表示抗爭並未結束，未來將返回台東重建家屋，並持續推動文化傳承與轉型正義，希望書籍能陪伴年輕人，為族群尊嚴與土地權益發聲。

sources.description:
Panai’s Golden Melody Awards Moment

At the 35th Golden Melody Awards in Taipei on June 29, 2024, Taiwanese singer and activist Panai accepted the Best Taiwanese Album award. Standing against an EVA Air backdrop, she held a bundle of rice stalks and wore a flowing dark ensemble accented with colorful accessories. 

In her acceptance speech, Panai marked the 35th anniversary of the Tiananmen Square crackdown, urging attendees to remember the 1989 pro-democracy protests. Her remarks underscored Taiwan’s freedom of expression and the ceremony’s celebration of music performed in Taiwanese and indigenous languages.

sources.description:
巴奈自傳發表會

Indigenous singer 巴奈 smiles as she holds her autobiography against a green backdrop inscribed with “一起和巴奈走在回家的路上…”. She wears a floral crown and a light-colored coat, standing in front of a collage of photographs depicting her protest marches and outdoor expeditions.

The event marks the launch of her memoir, chronicling seven years of activism since February 2017. Through music and art, she has campaigned on Ketagalan Boulevard and at 228 Peace Memorial Park for the full recognition of indigenous traditional territories. The display of images behind her underscores the long journey and resilience of her advocacy.
